name: ETL Google Analytics 4 To Azure Synapse Analytics
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Google Analytics 4 as the data source.
2.  Select your added Azure Synapse Analytics data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Google Analytics 4 account using OAuth, similar to the process described in this [Documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/set-up/authentication.html#_connecting_using_oauth) page.
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/google-analytics-4/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
